hadith_en: It was narrated from Anas ibn Malik  (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet (blessings and peace of Allah be upon him) said: “There are three characteristics, whoever has them will taste the sweetness of faith: the one for whom Allah and His Messenger are dearer than all others; the one who loves a person and only loves him for the sake of Allah (may He be glorified and exalted); and the one who would hate to go back to disbelief, after Allah has saved him from it, as he would hate to be thrown into the fire.”.
